name: scholarly-agent-suite
description: Evidence-first academic research and writing agent: one Skill with modules for execution planning, research evidence, scholarly writing, publication strategy, and pre-submission peer review.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-first academic research, writing, and publication strategy
interface.longDescription: An evidence-first, cross-disciplinary academic agent packaged as a single Skill, scholarly-agent. A dispatcher loads only the internal modules a request needs -- adaptive-model-router (execution planning), scholarly-corpus-builder (research evidence and style profiles), scholarly-voice-engine (scholarly writing), and journal-fit-engine (publication strategy) -- and hands data between them through versioned JSON protocols, with a non-negotiable integrity policy against fabricated citations, metrics, or acceptance predictions.
defaultPrompt: Use $scholarly-agent to help with this scholarly task.
Help me turn this research idea into a manuscript and find a journal.
Improve this manuscript and tell me where to submit it.
